scope: Refresh open-source ACIS reader/writer maturity and downstream FreeCAD route boundaries; reconcile evidence into existing parity gates without promoting support claims.

method.kind: Primary project release, issue, pull-request, and documentation pages plus read-only plan inspection
method.evidenceRule: Release notes are release-scoped; open issues and pull requests are reports/proposals, not reproduced results or released capabilities. Mutable or archived documentation defines a published route boundary only and does not substitute for a pinned native runtime.

observed: ACadSharp v3.6.51 release notes report ACIS payload reading for 3DSOLID, REGION, and BODY and AcDs offset work.
The listed v3.8.0 release entry adds assembly visibility and does not announce ACIS writer support.

Issue #1195 reports silent DXF-writer omission on ACadSharp 3.4.9, including 252 3DSOLID and 3 REGION entities in two customer drawings and solid-only blocks; the files were not supplied or reproduced in this review.
As viewed on 2026-10-16, PR #1240 is open and undeployed, proposes writing ACIS-dependent entities, and depends on ACDS/ACIS schema work in PR #1174.
doesNotEstablish: a writer result for ACadSharp v3.8.0
that the issue reproduces on the current ACadSharp release
semantic correctness of opaque ACIS payload pass-through
evidence.planUse: Keep ACadSharp reader, writer, release, and PR evidence separate. Do not wait for #1240 or count it as released capability. At the existing composed checkpoint, compare per-source identity/type, inline-versus-AcDs carrier, owner/block path, emitted record/payload, diagnostics, and INSERT target closure. Include a solid-only block plus INSERT only if absent from the current generated harness.

observed: The archived FreeCAD documentation page states that stock FreeCAD can only import/export 2D DXF data because the 3D data uses a proprietary format, and that DWG has the same limitation because the route converts through a DWG converter.

The same page includes a broad generic statement about no-loss DWG/DXF conversion that conflicts with its specific 3D limitation; the repository is archived, so neither sentence is a pinned runtime result.
doesNotEstablish: the behavior of a particular current FreeCAD build, converter, importer preference, or platform
that a valid ACIS DXF is malformed because stock FreeCAD does not consume it
that an external ACIS-capable FreeCAD add-on is part of the stock route
evidence.planUse: Keep stock FreeCAD native qualification focused on its documented 2D path. Classify stock 3DSOLID/REGION/BODY semantic checks as CONSUMER_NOT_APPLICABLE unless a distinct modeler route is pinned and executed. Do not use a conversion exit code or generic no-loss sentence as a 3D geometry pass.

evidence.topic: ezdxf structural ACIS utilities versus shape semantics
observed: The drawing add-on documents no ACIS rendering and no 3D rendering engine.
The browse-acis utility inspects and exports SAT/SAB payload content.
The entity-creation guide says the ACIS data itself must come from an external library.
doesNotEstablish: a version-pinned runtime result in this review
evidence.planUse: Use exact-version-pinned ezdxf only for the specific DXF parsing/writing or raw-payload operation exercised. Keep raw carrier, typed entity, closed valid shape, and displayed/consumed geometry as separate evidence layers.

implementationReadiness.solidOnlyBlockControl: Reuse current generated modeler-block harness; add locally authored control only if this exact topology is absent.
nextActions: Continue local implementation without waiting on ACadSharp PR #1240.
At the composed writer checkpoint, ensure every source ACIS entity has an emitted, refused-with-diagnostic, or explicitly unsupported disposition and retain owner/block/INSERT closure.
Keep FreeCAD native 2D qualification separate from ACIS semantic-reader qualification.
Leave J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
